text:
jon: @here Kepler-1 (model_id=kepler-1) is GA on Hosted API. Realtime endpoint (/v1/realtime) + streaming/tool-calling supported. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/kepler-1 :tada:

jon: Minimal realtime curl:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"kepler-1","input":"Create a short onboarding checklist","stream":true,"tool_call":true}'
```

priya: Note for SDK teams: streaming SDK v2 will be deprecated in 60 days. Migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate/realtime-v2-to-v3

jon: Breaking change: `tool_input` -> `tool_args`. Tool outputs must be JSON objects or we fallback to text. Strict validation opt-in via `?validation=strict`.

deploy-bot: deploy: kepler-1-realtime rolled to canary (us-east-2) at 1819000488. Monitoring traces/latency.

eng-oncall: Rollout gates: 0-5% canary (30m), 5-40% regional (2h), 40-100% global (12h). Rollback on error rate >0.8% or p95 latency >2x baseline.

support: Created KB "Kepler-1 GA: quick start & troubleshooting" and canned reply. Added on-call tag #kepler-1-ga.

jon: Defaults to add to limits doc: 150 concurrent realtime streams/org, 50k tokens/stream. Contact support for exceptions. Post-GA sync at 11:00 PT. Ping me for urgent issues. :rocket:
